/-! ## Regrouping the line answers by their evaluations -/

/-- Summing a paired-line answer against a family of point effects that
depends on the answer only through its two evaluations is summing the
evaluation classes of the paired-line measurement against that family.  This
is the fiber regrouping of the proofs of `lem:claim-17-1`, `lem:claim-17-2`,
and `lem:claim-17-3`, blueprint
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:2651-2830`. -/
theorem regroup_line_answer_sum_at {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ δP : ℝ}
    {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε} {points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ}
    (lines : CombinedLinesWitness S points δP)
    (first second : Placement)
    (lineX lineZ : LineDesc P.toLdParams) (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    (G : Option (PauliScalar P) → Option (PauliScalar P) →
      Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace second.side)) :
    (∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
        stateQForm S.psiHat
          ((S.placedMeasurement first
            ((lines.T first.side lineX lineZ).postprocess (fun fs =>
              (evalOpt lineX x fs.1, evalOpt lineZ z fs.2)))).effect o *
            S.place second (G o.1 o.2))) =
      ∑ fX, ∑ fZ, stateQForm S.psiHat
        (S.place first ((lines.T first.side lineX lineZ).effect (fX, fZ)) *
          S.place second (G (evalOpt lineX x fX) (evalOpt lineZ z fZ))) := by
  classical
  have hsum : ∀ (s : Finset (DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) ×
        DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d)))
      (M : DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) ×
        DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) →
        Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace first.side))
      (N : Op (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)),
      stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place first (∑ fs ∈ s, M fs) * N) =
        ∑ fs ∈ s, stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place first (M fs) * N) := by
    intro s M N
    rw [S.place_finsetSum]
    simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState, Finset.sum_mul]
  calc
    (∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
          stateQForm S.psiHat
            ((S.placedMeasurement first
              ((lines.T first.side lineX lineZ).postprocess (fun fs =>
                (evalOpt lineX x fs.1, evalOpt lineZ z fs.2)))).effect o *
              S.place second (G o.1 o.2))) =
        ∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
          ∑ fs ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun fs =>
              (evalOpt lineX x fs.1, evalOpt lineZ z fs.2) = o),
            stateQForm S.psiHat
              (S.place first ((lines.T first.side lineX lineZ).effect fs) *
                S.place second (G o.1 o.2)) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun o _ => ?_
      rw [ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect,
        MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
      exact hsum _ _ _
    _ = ∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
          ∑ fs ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun fs =>
              (evalOpt lineX x fs.1, evalOpt lineZ z fs.2) = o),
            stateQForm S.psiHat
              (S.place first ((lines.T first.side lineX lineZ).effect fs) *
                S.place second
                  (G (evalOpt lineX x fs.1) (evalOpt lineZ z fs.2))) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun o _ =>
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun fs hfs => ?_
      rw [← (Finset.mem_filter.mp hfs).2]
    _ = ∑ fs : DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) ×
          DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d),
          stateQForm S.psiHat
            (S.place first ((lines.T first.side lineX lineZ).effect fs) *
              S.place second
                (G (evalOpt lineX x fs.1) (evalOpt lineZ z fs.2))) :=
      Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun fs _ => Finset.mem_univ _) _
    _ = ∑ fX, ∑ fZ, stateQForm S.psiHat
          (S.place first ((lines.T first.side lineX lineZ).effect (fX, fZ)) *
            S.place second (G (evalOpt lineX x fX) (evalOpt lineZ z fZ))) :=
      Fintype.sum_prod_type (f := fun fs => stateQForm S.psiHat
        (S.place first ((lines.T first.side lineX lineZ).effect fs) *
          S.place second (G (evalOpt lineX x fs.1) (evalOpt lineZ z fs.2))))

theorem regroup_line_answer_sum {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ δP : ℝ}
    {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε} {points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ}
    (lines : CombinedLinesWitness S points δP)
    (lineX lineZ : LineDesc P.toLdParams) (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    (G : Option (PauliScalar P) → Option (PauliScalar P) →
      Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.BA''.side)) :
    (∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
        stateQForm S.psiHat
          ((S.placedMeasurement .AA'
            ((lines.T .alice lineX lineZ).postprocess (fun fs =>
              (evalOpt lineX x fs.1, evalOpt lineZ z fs.2)))).effect o *
            S.place .BA'' (G o.1 o.2))) =
      ∑ fX, ∑ fZ, stateQForm S.psiHat
        (S.place .AA' ((lines.T .alice lineX lineZ).effect (fX, fZ)) *
          S.place .BA'' (G (evalOpt lineX x fX) (evalOpt lineZ z fZ))) := by
  exact regroup_line_answer_sum_at lines .AA' .BA'' lineX lineZ x z G

/-- The sub-line average of a function of the two source lines and the
`X`-point of the sampled extended point is a mixture of averages over products
of two restricted line-point laws, the `X`-point being the point of the first
factor. This is the use of Property~2 of `lem:qld-sublines` in the proof of
`lem:claim-17-2`, blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex`,
paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1168-1201`. -/
theorem SubLineWitness.exists_avgOver_X_eq_mixture (P : AdmissibleParams)
    (sublines : SubLineWitness P)
    (F : (LineDesc P.toLdParams × LineDesc P.toLdParams) ×
      (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) → ℝ) :
    ∃ components : Distribution (SubLineComponent P), components.IsProbability ∧
      avgOver sublines.D (fun sample =>
          avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd))
            (fun t => F (sample.2, projX (directPointToPauli P
              (sample.1.base + t • sample.1.direction))))) =
        avgOver components (fun c =>
          avgOver (Distribution.prod (restrictedLinePointDist P c.1 c.2.1)
              (restrictedLinePointDist P c.1 c.2.2))
            (fun w => F ((w.1.1, w.2.1), w.1.2))) := by
  obtain ⟨components, hcomp, hX, -⟩ := sublines.source_mixture
  refine ⟨components, hcomp, ?_⟩
  have h1 : avgOver sublines.D (fun sample =>
      avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd))
        (fun t => F (sample.2, projX (directPointToPauli P
          (sample.1.base + t • sample.1.direction))))) =
      avgOver ((subLinePointDist P sublines.D).map subLineXProjection) F := by
    rw [Distribution.avgOver_map, subLinePointDist, Distribution.avgOver_map,
      avgOver_prod]
    rfl
  rw [h1, hX, avgOver_bind]
  refine avgOver_congr _ _ _ fun c => ?_
  rw [subLineXComponentDist, Distribution.avgOver_map, Distribution.prod_map_right,
    Distribution.avgOver_map]

/-- The sub-line average of a function of the two source lines and the
`Z`-point of the sampled extended point is a mixture of averages over products
of two restricted line-point laws, the `Z`-point being the point of the second
factor.  This is the use of Property~2 of `lem:qld-sublines` in the proof of
`lem:claim-17-3`, blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex`,
paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1204-1239`. -/
theorem SubLineWitness.exists_avgOver_Z_eq_mixture (P : AdmissibleParams)
    (sublines : SubLineWitness P)
    (F : (LineDesc P.toLdParams × LineDesc P.toLdParams) ×
      (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) → ℝ) :
    ∃ components : Distribution (SubLineComponent P), components.IsProbability ∧
      avgOver sublines.D (fun sample =>
          avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd))
            (fun t => F (sample.2, projZ (directPointToPauli P
              (sample.1.base + t • sample.1.direction))))) =
        avgOver components (fun c =>
          avgOver (Distribution.prod (restrictedLinePointDist P c.1 c.2.1)
              (restrictedLinePointDist P c.1 c.2.2))
            (fun w => F ((w.1.1, w.2.1), w.2.2))) := by
  obtain ⟨components, hcomp, -, hZ⟩ := sublines.source_mixture
  refine ⟨components, hcomp, ?_⟩
  have h1 : avgOver sublines.D (fun sample =>
      avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd))
        (fun t => F (sample.2, projZ (directPointToPauli P
          (sample.1.base + t • sample.1.direction))))) =
      avgOver ((subLinePointDist P sublines.D).map subLineZProjection) F := by
    rw [Distribution.avgOver_map, subLinePointDist, Distribution.avgOver_map,
      avgOver_prod]
    rfl
  rw [h1, hZ, avgOver_bind]
  refine avgOver_congr _ _ _ fun c => ?_
  rw [subLineZComponentDist, Distribution.avgOver_map, Distribution.prod_map_left,
    Distribution.avgOver_map]

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSource.lean:5:# The projected marginals of the sub-line law
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSource.lean:6:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSource.lean:7:This module identifies the two projected point marginals of the sub-line law
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSource.lean:8:of `lem:qld-sublines` as mixtures of the restricted product laws.  The two
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSource.lean:9:source lines of a sampled triple depend on the drawn extended point only
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSource.lean:10:through the canonical representatives of its two source blocks, and those
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSource.lean:11:representatives are unchanged when the drawn point is replaced by any point of
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSource.lean:12:the extended line; a uniform point of the extended line through a uniform
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSource.lean:13:point is a uniform point, so the drawn point may be replaced throughout by the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSource.lean:14:point that is finally retained.  The six generating blocks of the resulting
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSource.lean:15:law -- the two source point blocks, the two scalar seeds and the two source
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSource.lean:16:direction blocks -- are then regrouped into the two restricted product laws
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSource.lean:17:carried by the two indices of the branch.

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineMixture.lean:6:This module assembles the two projected point marginals of the sub-line law of
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineMixture.lean:7:`lem:qld-sublines` into mixtures of the restricted product laws.  Drawing a
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineMixture.lean:8:uniform point of the extended line of a mixture of line laws is the same
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineMixture.lean:9:mixture of the corresponding uniform-point laws, so the two projected
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineMixture.lean:10:marginals of the sub-line law are the mixtures, over the drawn kind and the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineMixture.lean:11:drawn extended coordinate, of the projected marginals of one branch at one
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineMixture.lean:12:extended coordinate.  Each of those is the component law of the pair of
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineMixture.lean:13:indices carried by that branch, so the mixing law is the law of the kind
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineMixture.lean:14:together with the pair of indices assigned to a uniform extended coordinate.

    37	/-- Place an Alice-side measurement on `AA'` by the current tensor
    38	bipartition API. -/
    39	private noncomputable def placedAAMeasurement {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    40	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    41	    (M : Measurement α (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)) :
    42	    Measurement α (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=

    44	    (ProjectiveSetting.aaBaBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)

    47	/-- The effects of `placedAAMeasurement` are the `AA'` placements of the
    48	original effects. -/
    49	private theorem placedAAMeasurement_effect {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    50	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    51	    (M : Measurement α (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)) (a : α) :
    52	    (placedAAMeasurement S M).effect a = S.place .AA' (M.effect a) := by
    53	  change reindexOp
    54	    (ProjectiveSetting.aaBaBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    55	      (heteroKron (M.effect a) 1) = S.place .AA' (M.effect a)
    56	  exact ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_aaBaBipartition_left S (M.effect a)

    58	/-- A product-distribution average is the corresponding iterated average. -/
    59	private theorem avgOver_prod_current {α β : Type*}
    60	    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    61	    (μ : Distribution α) (ν : Distribution β) (f : α × β → ℝ) :
    62	    avgOver (Distribution.prod μ ν) f =
    63	      avgOver μ (fun a => avgOver ν (fun b => f (a, b))) := by
    64	  classical
    65	  unfold avgOver
    66	  change (∑ p ∈ μ.support ×ˢ ν.support,
    67	    μ.weight p.1 * ν.weight p.2 * f p) = _
    68	  rw [Finset.sum_product]
    69	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    70	  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    71	  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => by ring

    73	/-- The completed point measurement has zero effect at `none`. -/
    74	private theorem pointMeasExpOption_effect_none_current
    75	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ} (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)

    82	  intro a ha
    83	  exact absurd (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2 (by simp)

    98	/-- Evaluating a completed point effect through a line answer gives the
    99	explicit zero-completed effect used in the claim statements. -/
   100	private theorem pointMeasExpOption_effect_evalOpt_current
   101	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ} (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   102	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (line : LineDesc P.toLdParams)
   103	    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
   104	    (f : DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d)) :
   105	    (S.pointMeasExpOption side W u).effect (evalOpt line u f) =
   106	      S.expPointEffectAtLineAnswer side W line u f := by
   107	  unfold ProjectiveSetting.expPointEffectAtLineAnswer
   108	  cases evalOpt line u f with
   109	  | none => exact pointMeasExpOption_effect_none_current S side W u
   110	  | some a => exact pointMeasExpOption_effect_some_current S side W u a

   112	private theorem rpow_quarter_nonneg (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ Real.rpow x (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
   113	  change 0 ≤ x ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)
   114	  rcases lt_or_ge x 0 with hx | hx
   115	  · rw [Real.rpow_def_of_neg hx,
   116	      show (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.pi = Real.pi / 4 by ring, Real.cos_pi_div_four]
   117	    positivity
   118	  · exact Real.rpow_nonneg hx _

   120	private theorem sqrt_deficit_bound_le (m δP δQ : ℝ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hP : 0 ≤ δP)
   121	    (hQ : 0 ≤ δQ) :
   122	    Real.sqrt (2 * Real.sqrt (4 * m ^ 2 * δP) + 2 * Real.sqrt (4 * δQ)) ≤
   123	      2 * Real.sqrt m * (Real.rpow δP (1 / 4 : ℝ) + Real.rpow δQ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) := by
   124	  have hm0 : 0 ≤ m := by linarith
   125	  have hsqrtm : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt m := by
   126	    rw [← Real.sqrt_one]
   127	    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hm
   128	  have h1 : Real.sqrt (4 * m ^ 2 * δP) = 2 * m * Real.sqrt δP := by
   129	    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), show (4 * m ^ 2 : ℝ) = (2 * m) ^ 2 by ring,
   130	      Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)]
   131	  have h2 : Real.sqrt (4 * δQ) = 2 * Real.sqrt δQ := by
   132	    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num), show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num,
   133	      Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]
   134	  have hquarter : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x →
   135	      Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt x) = Real.rpow x (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
   136	    intro x hx
   137	    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul hx]
   138	    norm_num
   139	  have hsplit : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b →
   140	      Real.sqrt (a + b) ≤ Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b := by
   141	    intro a b ha hb
   142	    rw [← Real.sqrt_sq (add_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg a) (Real.sqrt_nonneg b))]
   143	    refine Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ?_
   144	    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt ha, Real.sq_sqrt hb, Real.sqrt_nonneg a,
   145	      Real.sqrt_nonneg b]
   146	  have hPa : 0 ≤ 2 * (2 * m * Real.sqrt δP) :=
   147	    mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
   148	      (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hm0) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
   149	  have hQa : 0 ≤ 2 * (2 * Real.sqrt δQ) :=
   150	    mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
   151	  have hPb : Real.sqrt (2 * (2 * m * Real.sqrt δP)) =
   152	      2 * Real.sqrt m * Real.rpow δP (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
   153	    rw [show 2 * (2 * m * Real.sqrt δP) = 2 ^ 2 * m * Real.sqrt δP by ring,
   154	      Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ 2),
   155	      Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), hquarter δP hP]
   156	  have hQb : Real.sqrt (2 * (2 * Real.sqrt δQ)) = 2 * Real.rpow δQ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
   157	    rw [show 2 * (2 * Real.sqrt δQ) = 2 ^ 2 * Real.sqrt δQ by ring,
   158	      Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ 2),
   159	      Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), hquarter δQ hQ]
   160	  rw [h1, h2]
   161	  calc
   162	    Real.sqrt (2 * (2 * m * Real.sqrt δP) + 2 * (2 * Real.sqrt δQ))
   163	        ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * (2 * m * Real.sqrt δP)) +
   164	          Real.sqrt (2 * (2 * Real.sqrt δQ)) := hsplit _ _ hPa hQa
   165	    _ = 2 * Real.sqrt m * Real.rpow δP (1 / 4 : ℝ) +
   166	          2 * Real.rpow δQ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by rw [hPb, hQb]
   167	    _ ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt m *
   168	          (Real.rpow δP (1 / 4 : ℝ) + Real.rpow δQ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) := by
   169	      have hQ4 : 0 ≤ Real.rpow δQ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hQ _
   170	      nlinarith [hsqrtm, hQ4]

   172	/-- Regroup paired-line answers by their two optional evaluations. -/
   173	private theorem regroup_placed_line_answer_sum {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ δP : ℝ}
   174	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε} {points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ}
   175	    (lines : CombinedLinesWitness S points δP)
   176	    (lineX lineZ : LineDesc P.toLdParams) (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
   177	    (G : Option (PauliScalar P) → Option (PauliScalar P) →
   178	      Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.BA''.side)) :
   179	    (∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
   180	        stateQForm S.psiHat
   181	          (((placedAAMeasurement S (lines.T .alice lineX lineZ)).postprocess
   182	            (fun fs => (evalOpt lineX x fs.1, evalOpt lineZ z fs.2))).effect o *
   183	            S.place .BA'' (G o.1 o.2))) =
   184	      ∑ fX, ∑ fZ, stateQForm S.psiHat
   185	        (S.place .AA' ((lines.T .alice lineX lineZ).effect (fX, fZ)) *
   186	          S.place .BA'' (G (evalOpt lineX x fX) (evalOpt lineZ z fZ))) := by
   187	  classical
   188	  have hsum : ∀ (s : Finset (DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) ×
   189	        DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d)))
   190	      (M : DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) ×
   191	        DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) →
   192	        Op (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB))
   193	      (N : Op (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)),
   194	      stateQForm S.psiHat ((∑ fs ∈ s, M fs) * N) =
   195	        ∑ fs ∈ s, stateQForm S.psiHat (M fs * N) := by
   196	    intro s M N
   197	    simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState, Finset.sum_mul]
   198	  calc
   199	    (∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
   200	          stateQForm S.psiHat
   201	            (((placedAAMeasurement S
   202	              (lines.T .alice lineX lineZ)).postprocess (fun fs =>
   203	                (evalOpt lineX x fs.1, evalOpt lineZ z fs.2))).effect o *
   204	              S.place .BA'' (G o.1 o.2))) =
   205	        ∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
   206	          ∑ fs ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun fs =>
   207	              (evalOpt lineX x fs.1, evalOpt lineZ z fs.2) = o),
   208	            stateQForm S.psiHat
   209	              (S.place .AA' ((lines.T .alice lineX lineZ).effect fs) *
   210	                S.place .BA'' (G o.1 o.2)) := by
   211	      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun o _ => ?_
   212	      rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   213	      refine (hsum _ _ _).trans ?_
   214	      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun fs _ => by
   215	        rw [placedAAMeasurement_effect]
   216	    _ = ∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
   217	          ∑ fs ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun fs =>
   218	              (evalOpt lineX x fs.1, evalOpt lineZ z fs.2) = o),
   219	            stateQForm S.psiHat
   220	              (S.place .AA' ((lines.T .alice lineX lineZ).effect fs) *
   221	                S.place .BA''
   222	                  (G (evalOpt lineX x fs.1) (evalOpt lineZ z fs.2))) := by
   223	      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun o _ =>
   224	        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun fs hfs => ?_
   225	      rw [← (Finset.mem_filter.mp hfs).2]
   226	    _ = ∑ fs : DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) ×
   227	          DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d),
   228	          stateQForm S.psiHat
   229	            (S.place .AA' ((lines.T .alice lineX lineZ).effect fs) *
   230	              S.place .BA''
   231	                (G (evalOpt lineX x fs.1) (evalOpt lineZ z fs.2))) :=
   232	      Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun fs _ => Finset.mem_univ _) _
   233	    _ = ∑ fX, ∑ fZ, stateQForm S.psiHat
   234	          (S.place .AA' ((lines.T .alice lineX lineZ).effect (fX, fZ)) *
   235	            S.place .BA'' (G (evalOpt lineX x fX) (evalOpt lineZ z fZ))) :=
   236	      Fintype.sum_prod_type (f := fun fs => stateQForm S.psiHat
   237	        (S.place .AA' ((lines.T .alice lineX lineZ).effect fs) *
   238	          S.place .BA'' (G (evalOpt lineX x fs.1) (evalOpt lineZ z fs.2))))

   240	/-- Completing both outcome coordinates with `none` does not change the
   241	squared distance sum between the joint and ordered point families. -/
   242	private theorem completed_pair_norm_sq_sum {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ : ℝ}
   243	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε} (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ)
   244	    (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
   245	    (∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
   246	        ‖applyOperatorToState
   247	          (S.place .BA'' (((points.Q .bob x z).postprocess (fun ab =>
   248	              (some ab.1, some ab.2))).effect (o.1, o.2)) -
   249	            S.place .BA''
   250	              ((S.pointMeasExpOption .bob .Z z).effect o.2 *
   251	                (S.pointMeasExpOption .bob .X x).effect o.1))
   252	          S.psiHat‖ ^ 2) =
   253	      ∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P,
   254	        ‖applyOperatorToState
   255	          (S.place .BA'' ((points.Q .bob x z).effect ab) -
   256	            S.place .BA''
   257	              ((S.pointMeasExp .bob .Z z).effect ab.2 *
   258	                (S.pointMeasExp .bob .X x).effect ab.1))
   259	          S.psiHat‖ ^ 2 := by
   260	  classical
   261	  have hXnone : ((S.pointMeasExpOption .bob .X x).effect
   262	      (none : Option (PauliScalar P)) :
   263	        Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.BA''.side)) = 0 :=
   264	    pointMeasExpOption_effect_none_current S .bob .X x
   265	  have hZnone : ((S.pointMeasExpOption .bob .Z z).effect
   266	      (none : Option (PauliScalar P)) :
   267	        Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.BA''.side)) = 0 :=
   268	    pointMeasExpOption_effect_none_current S .bob .Z z
   269	  have hXsome : ∀ a : PauliScalar P,
   270	      ((S.pointMeasExpOption .bob .X x).effect (some a) :
   271	        Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.BA''.side)) =
   272	        (S.pointMeasExp .bob .X x).effect a :=
   273	    fun a => pointMeasExpOption_effect_some_current S .bob .X x a
   274	  have hZsome : ∀ b : PauliScalar P,
   275	      ((S.pointMeasExpOption .bob .Z z).effect (some b) :
   276	        Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.BA''.side)) =
   277	        (S.pointMeasExp .bob .Z z).effect b :=
   278	    fun b => pointMeasExpOption_effect_some_current S .bob .Z z b
   279	  have hQnone : ∀ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P),
   280	      (∀ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P, (some ab.1, some ab.2) ≠ o) →
   281	      ((((points.Q .bob x z).postprocess fun ab =>
   282	          (some ab.1, some ab.2)).effect o) :
   283	        Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.BA''.side)) = 0 := by
   284	    intro o ho
   285	    rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   286	    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun ab hab =>
   287	      absurd (Finset.mem_filter.mp hab).2 (ho ab)
   288	  have hQsome : ∀ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P,
   289	      ((((points.Q .bob x z).postprocess fun cd =>
   290	          (some cd.1, some cd.2)).effect (some ab.1, some ab.2)) :
   291	        Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.BA''.side)) =
   292	        (points.Q .bob x z).effect ab := by
   293	    intro ab
   294	    rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
   295	      show (Finset.univ.filter fun cd : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P =>
   296	          (some cd.1, some cd.2) = (some ab.1, some ab.2)) = {ab} by
   297	        ext cd
   298	        simp [Prod.ext_iff, eq_comm]]
   299	    simp
   300	  have hkey : ∀ (F : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P) → ℝ),
   301	      (∀ o2, F (none, o2) = 0) → (∀ o1, F (o1, none) = 0) →
   302	      (∑ o, F o) =
   303	        ∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P, F (some ab.1, some ab.2) := by
   304	    intro F h1 h2
   305	    calc
   306	      (∑ o : Option (PauliScalar P) × Option (PauliScalar P), F o) =
   307	          ∑ o1 : Option (PauliScalar P), ∑ o2 : Option (PauliScalar P),
   308	            F (o1, o2) := Fintype.sum_prod_type (f := F)
   309	      _ = (∑ o2 : Option (PauliScalar P), F (none, o2)) +
   310	            ∑ a : PauliScalar P, ∑ o2 : Option (PauliScalar P),
   311	              F (some a, o2) := Fintype.sum_option _
   312	      _ = ∑ a : PauliScalar P, ∑ o2 : Option (PauliScalar P),
   313	            F (some a, o2) := by

4:/-!
5:# Orthonormalization of the sandwich POVM
6:
7:For each fixed point pair `(x, z)`, the sandwich POVM `R^{x,z}` on one
8:register placement is consistent with the sandwich POVM on the opposite
9:placement, with the consistency defect bounded by
10:`ProjectiveSetting.sandwichDefectBound`.  The orthonormalization lemma
11:`lem:ortho`, in its explicit-constant form
12:`projective_rounding_with_explicit_constant`, therefore produces a projective
13:measurement `Q^{x,z}` on the original local space, within `220 · c^{1/4}` of
14:`R^{x,z}` on the expanded state, where `c` is that bound.  Choosing such a
15:measurement for every pair and averaging, the concavity of `t ↦ t^{1/4}`
16:turns the average of the fiberwise errors into the same function of the
17:average defect.
18:
19:The orthonormalization lemma is stated for a bipartite state whose first
20:tensor factor carries the POVM to be rounded.  The two bipartitions used are
21:`AA' | BA''(B'B'')`, for Alice's measurements, and `BA'' | AA'(B'B'')`, for
22:Bob's; the second is introduced here.
23:
24:## Main results
25:
26:* `baAaBipartition` with its two placement lemmas.
27:* `avgOver_rpow_quarter_le`: Jensen's inequality for the fourth root.
28:* `ProjectiveSetting.exists_projective_close_sandwich`: the fiberwise
29:  orthonormalization, for any bipartition exhibiting the two placements as
30:  the two tensor factors.

def subLineFirstIndex (P : AdmissibleParams) : Fin P.m :=
  ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one P.one_le_m⟩

/-- The coordinate index carried by the source `X` line of a branch: the
stored extended coordinate when it is an `X`-block coordinate, and the first
coordinate otherwise.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
def subLineXIndex (P : AdmissibleParams) (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) : Fin P.m :=
  if h : k.val < P.m then ⟨k.val, h⟩ else subLineFirstIndex P

/-- The coordinate index carried by the source `Z` line of a branch: the
stored extended coordinate when it is a `Z`-block coordinate, and the first
coordinate otherwise.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
def subLineZIndex (P : AdmissibleParams) (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) : Fin P.m :=
  if h : P.m ≤ k.val ∧ k.val < 2 * P.m then ⟨k.val - P.m, by omega⟩
  else subLineFirstIndex P

/-- At an `X`-block coordinate the source `X` line carries that coordinate. -/
theorem subLineXIndex_embX (P : AdmissibleParams) (i : Fin P.m) :
    subLineXIndex P (embX P.m i) = i := by
  have h : (embX P.m i).val < P.m := by
    rw [embX_val]
    exact i.isLt
  rw [subLineXIndex, dif_pos h]
  exact Fin.ext (embX_val P.m i)

/-- At a `Z`-block coordinate the source `X` line carries the first
coordinate. -/
theorem subLineXIndex_embZ (P : AdmissibleParams) (j : Fin P.m) :
    subLineXIndex P (embZ P.m j) = subLineFirstIndex P := by
  have h : ¬ (embZ P.m j).val < P.m := by
    rw [embZ_val]
    omega
  rw [subLineXIndex, dif_neg h]

/-- At the first scalar coordinate the source `X` line carries the first
coordinate. -/
theorem subLineXIndex_alphaVar (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    subLineXIndex P (alphaVar P.m) = subLineFirstIndex P := by
  have h : ¬ (alphaVar P.m).val < P.m := by
    rw [alphaVar_val]
    omega
  rw [subLineXIndex, dif_neg h]

/-- At the second scalar coordinate the source `X` line carries the first
coordinate. -/
theorem subLineXIndex_betaVar (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    subLineXIndex P (betaVar P.m) = subLineFirstIndex P := by
  have h : ¬ (betaVar P.m).val < P.m := by
    rw [betaVar_val]
    omega
  rw [subLineXIndex, dif_neg h]

/-- At an `X`-block coordinate the source `Z` line carries the first
coordinate. -/
theorem subLineZIndex_embX (P : AdmissibleParams) (i : Fin P.m) :
    subLineZIndex P (embX P.m i) = subLineFirstIndex P := by
  have h : ¬ (P.m ≤ (embX P.m i).val ∧ (embX P.m i).val < 2 * P.m) := by
    rw [embX_val]
    have := i.isLt
    omega
  rw [subLineZIndex, dif_neg h]

## Review

**F1: Scalar conclusion mismatch.** The blueprint defines scalar approximation using absolute difference at `ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:46` and displays complex expectation values at line 1596. However, `Claims.lean:362` and `:377` take `.re` before comparing them. The ordered product need not be Hermitian, so bounding the real part does not establish the displayed complex-modulus estimate. Restore the source-shaped conclusion, or retain the real-part result as a separate auxiliary entry without claiming completion of the source statement.

**F2: Distribution-domain mismatch.** The surrounding blueprint fixes the source distribution at `ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:1531`. In contrast, `UniformLinePoint.lean:261` and `Claims.lean:346` require `SubLineWitness`, whose documentation explicitly distinguishes its directly indexed law from the source law (`Witnesses.lean:239`). `Lines.lean:315` also states that transport remains open. State the directly indexed domain explicitly in separate support entries; it cannot justify the source Claim 17-1 completion tags without that transport. Apply the same distinction when recording the newly completed Claim 17-3.

**F3: Proof-sketch mismatch.** At `ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:1632`, the sketch bounds an expectation of \(W^2\) by \(\delta_Q\). Lean instead bounds squared norms, corresponding to \(W^\dagger W\), by \(4\delta_Q\) (`Claims.lean:447`, `:506`), obtaining \(2\sqrt{\delta_Q}\). Correct both the quadratic expression and the explicit constants; \(W\) is not generally Hermitian.

**F4: Combined-point synchronization.** The blueprint proof beginning at `ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:846` still uses binary refinements, quantum linearity, and additional zero-state padding. The new proof explicitly avoids that construction (`Points.lean:54`), using field-valued sandwiches, orthonormalization, and triangle inequalities. Update the proof sketch and `\uses`, then add proof-level `\leanok`. Its dependency report contains no `sorryAx`.

**F5: Restricted-distribution status.** The normalization results and all four declarations linked at `ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:1268` are now proved without `sorryAx`. Nevertheless, the definition at line 1251 and mixture lemma at line 1271 retain `\notready`, and the latter lacks proof-level `\leanok`. Synchronize these entries with the completed normalization, mixture, and inflation results.

**F6: Missing X-deficit entry.** Neither `concreteXPointOverlap`, `exists_concreteXPointOverlap_deficit_le`, nor `combinedLineMeasurement_sum_Z` appears in the blueprint links. Record the constructed measurement’s marginal identity and deficit estimate as subordinate mathematical entries, explicitly stating the directly indexed domain and connecting them to Claim 17-2 through `\uses`. Keep the full Claim 17-2 proof unmarked: its remaining obligation is distinct from this completed estimate.

**F7: Readiness versus completion.** The statement at `ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:1059` already matches `combined_line_measurement_consistency` (`Lines.lean:53`). Its proof is unfinished, not its statement. Remove `\notready`; retain the separate traceability link without `\leanok`, since the declaration still depends on `sorryAx`.

**F8: Prose.** Replace “Place an Alice-side measurement on `AA'` by the current tensor bipartition API” with “Place an Alice-side measurement on `AA'` using the corresponding tensor bipartition.”
